bills.title: Better and Fairer Schools (Funding and Reform) Bill 2024

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-11-26.264.1) introduced by Queensland Senator [Penny Allman-Payne](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/queensland/penny_allman-payne) (Greens), which means they failed. Senator Allman-Payne explained that the [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-11-26.264.1): > *...seek to amend section 35A of the Australian Education Act 2013 to raise the share of the Commonwealth's contribution to public schools to 25 per cent.* ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 3, page 4 (line 11), omit "20 per cent", substitute "25 per cent".* > > *(2) Schedule 1, item 7, page 5 (line 19), omit "20%", substitute "25%".*
